research_questions.question: Does typed protocol-property IR improve semantic assertion quality over direct generation and template-only baselines?
research_questions.falsifiable_claim: V3 full has higher held-out executable-and-non-vacuous rate and mutation kill rate without higher known-good false-positive rate.

research_questions.question: Does typed binding improve transfer across CoupledL2 variants?
research_questions.falsifiable_claim: Typed anchor transfer improves executable transfer and lowers wrong-but-compilable binding rate.

research_questions.question: Does deterministic transaction reconstruction improve diagnosis?
research_questions.falsifiable_claim: Structured traces improve adjudicated diagnosis macro-F1 over raw formal output.

hypotheses.claim: V3 full improves held-out bug detection over direct-LLM and template-only baselines.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: The paired held-out mutation and historical-bug results do not improve or known-good false positives worsen.

hypotheses.claim: Typed anchors improve executable binding transfer and reduce semantic misbinding.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Typed transfer does not outperform lexical/path matching or increases wrong-but-compilable bindings.

hypotheses.claim: Deterministic reconstruction improves independently adjudicated diagnosis.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Macro-F1 or agreement does not improve over raw formal log and waveform inputs.

hypotheses.claim: The direction of benefit persists across at least two models, multiple seeds, and bug-lineage-grouped splits.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: The result depends on one model, one seed, or near-duplicate source leakage.

benchmark_units.rtl_label: one elaborated property label; labels from one instance are clustered
benchmark_units.mutant: one compiling, independently classified mutation instance
benchmark_units.bug_lineage: the primary unit for held-out generalization

methods.description: normative clause plus scoped RTL to candidate assertion
V2 typed record and template without V3 compiler or oracle plan
candidate assertion with compilation and JasperGold repair feedback
typed IR, deterministic compiler, typed binding, witness and negative oracle gates
Codex-reviewed package; excluded from automated-method comparisons

success_criteria: At least 12 validated obligations cover six required semantic shapes
Every experiment-eligible package passes positive witness, applicable observer reachability, assumption satisfiability, negative oracle, compile, and RTL identity
V3 full improves held-out bug detection without substituting compile rate for functional quality
stopping_rules: Stop if improvement is limited to compile rate
Stop asset expansion if semantic-shape coverage or mutation kill does not increase
Stop transfer claims if success depends on unchanged paths or vacuous antecedents
Do not publish a positive conclusion that depends on deleting timeout, missing, or inconclusive results
